gloss: in a meeting; during a meeting

definitions.gloss: in a meeting; during a meeting
definitions.explanation: Indicates that someone is currently attending a meeting and is unavailable. Commonly seen on signs and used as a status indicator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会議中|かいぎちゅう}です。
examples.english: The department head is in a meeting.

examples.japanese: {会議中|かいぎちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦マナーモード→マナーモード：07687_manaamoodo⟧にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put your phone on silent mode during the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{会議中|かいぎちゅう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっていた→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{入|はい}らなかった→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was an "In Meeting" sign on the door, so I didn't go in.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (meeting) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during). The suffix 〜⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ can be attached to many activity nouns to mean "in the middle of" (e.g., {食事中|しょくじちゅう}, ⟦{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}→授業中：20544_jugyouchuu⟧).

Often displayed on door signs or as a status message in business settings. In modern contexts, also used as an online status indicator.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会議中|かいぎちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (a phone call during a meeting)
- ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧{会議中|かいぎちゅう}です (currently in a meeting — polite)
